sources.title: Axion dark matter with not quite black hole domination

evidence.text: How does a pre-BBN epoch dominated by primordial 2-2-holes alter misalignment-produced QCD axion dark matter, and what restrictions follow for the initial hole population and remnant mass when remnants supply only a small DM fraction?

sources.title: QCD axion dark matter in the dark dimension

evidence.text: Can resonant conversion from an axion-like particle supply the missing QCD axion dark matter abundance when the dark dimension scenario restricts the QCD axion decay constant to approximately 10^9–10^10 GeV?

sources.title: Axion dark matter with not quite black hole domination

evidence.text: Determine axion oscillation onset from 3H(Tosc) = m̃a(Tosc), then calculate the relic abundance using the mass change, entropy densities, and dilution factor S(Tosc)/S(Tτ). Separate expressions apply above and below the QCD transition.

sources.title: QCD axion dark matter in the dark dimension

evidence.text: Misalignment densities are propagated using conserved comoving particle number N = ρa^3/m in adiabatic evolution. The ALP density at resonance is transferred to the QCD axion and subsequently redshifted to obtain the enhanced relic abundance.

sources.title: Axion dark matter with not quite black hole domination

evidence.text: Estimate anharmonic effects by replacing θi² with θi² fanh(θi), using an imported correction for a cosine potential. These corrections are displayed in the initial mass-window analysis but omitted from subsequent analysis because their effects are reported to be small there.

sources.title: Axion dark matter with not quite black hole domination

evidence.text: Use coupled Boltzmann equations for hole and radiation energy densities, with energy transfer proportional to the hole mass-loss rate, together with H² = 8π(ρR + ρ)/(3mPl²). The paper uses approximate analytic solutions across temperature intervals rather than a full numerical evolution.

sources.title: QCD axion dark matter in the dark dimension

evidence.text: The author diagonalizes the small-amplitude two-field mass matrix into heavy and light eigenstates and defines the resonance temperature by the minimum squared-mass splitting. For fA much larger than fa, the resonance approximately satisfies ma(TR) = mA.

sources.title: Diluting the inflationary axion fluctuation by a stronger QCD in the early Universe

evidence.text: Can supersymmetric axion models accommodate high-scale primordial inflation, sufficiently small axion isocurvature, and axions constituting all dark matter through an early period of stronger QCD?

evidence.text: Estimate conversion semi-analytically by integrating the homogeneous-domain conversion probability per unit length over energy, emitting volume, and a coherence-length distribution inferred from the magnetic spectrum. The domain-length interval is Λmin/2 to Λmax/2.

sources.title: Do We Live in the Swampland?

evidence.text: Can a rolling hidden QCD amplitude supply the missing axion slope while avoiding a direct visible-nucleon force? The construction uses a shared axion and aligned visible and mirror cosine potentials.

sources.title: Leading logs in QCD axion effective field theory

evidence.text: When does identifying the ultraviolet cutoff of a logarithmically divergent axion EFT loop with f_a reproduce a complete QCD axion model, particularly for K⁺→π⁺a? Can a renormalizable model realize the large logarithm without additional states below the PQ scale?

sources.title: Axions in the dark dimension

evidence.text: Can a QCD axion solving the strong CP problem satisfy observations in a theory with one micron-scale extra dimension, and how do its predictions differ between localization on the Standard Model brane and propagation in the five-dimensional bulk?

sources.title: Probing a QCD string axion with precision cosmological measurements

evidence.text: Can primordial gravitational waves, together with CMB isocurvature and non-Gaussianity bounds, test a string/M-theory QCD axion without fixing its initial misalignment, dark-matter fraction, or allowed late-particle entropy dilution?

sources.title: String Axiverse

evidence.text: Conditional on a string QCD axion solving strong CP naturally, should many additional ultralight axions exist, and how could cosmological observations and rotating black holes reveal their masses and couplings?

sources.title: String compactification, QCD axion and axion-photon-photon coupling

evidence.text: Can a phenomenologically viable heterotic compactification supply a QCD axion with an experimentally accessible decay constant, after imposing realistic Yukawa couplings, hidden-sector confinement and axion mixing? What axion-photon-photon coupling follows?

sources.title: UV and IR effects in axion quality control

evidence.text: How does the higher-dimensional form-field origin of axions change their UV sensitivity, the QCD axion quality problem, and the relation between decay constants and observable matter couplings? evidence.text: How does chiral EFT encode QCD topology, vacuum alignment and strong CP observables, and how do axions, orientifold theories and proposed phase-alignment prescriptions modify this description?

evidence.text: How do the QCD axion and more general axion-like particles arise, acquire masses and Standard Model couplings, populate the Universe, and produce observable particle or gravitational signatures? This is a short pedagogical review.

evidence.text: Can an M-theory-inspired ultralight axion supply all dark matter while a separate QCD axion solves strong CP, without the usual overproduction at GUT-scale decay constants, and with testable couplings or residual CP violation?
